_meta.title: Generic Standard on Printed Board Design
_meta.note: Values extracted from IPC-2221B tables. Always verify with the authoritative standard for production designs.

conductor_spacing_internal.description: Minimum conductor spacing for internal layers (B2 class), IPC-2221B Table 6-1

conductor_spacing_external_coated.description: Minimum conductor spacing for external layers, with conformal coating, IPC-2221B Table 6-1

conductor_spacing_external_uncoated.description: Minimum conductor spacing for external layers, no conformal coating (sea level to 3050m), IPC-2221B Table 6-1

trace_width_external_1oz.description: Minimum trace width for external layers, 1oz Cu (35µm), 10°C temperature rise, IPC-2221B Chart 6-2

trace_width_internal_1oz.description: Minimum trace width for internal layers, 1oz Cu, 10°C temperature rise, IPC-2221B Chart 6-2

annular_ring_minimums.description: Minimum annular ring (pad to hole edge), IPC-2221B §9.1

hole_sizes.description: Hole diameter tolerances and drill-to-copper clearances, IPC-2221B §9
hole_sizes.note: Most fab houses impose min 0.20mm drill, 0.10mm annular ring

via_rules.description: Via design rules, common fab constraints
via_rules.note: Aspect ratio = board_thickness / drill_diameter. Values > 10 unreliable.

board_edge_clearance.description: Minimum clearance from copper to board edge

thermal_relief.description: Thermal relief spoke parameters for through-hole components in copper planes

PTFE_Teflon.note: Excellent RF performance, expensive, difficult to process

spacing_voltage_lookup.description: Function to find minimum spacing from voltage
spacing_voltage_lookup.usage: Use get_design_rules() from rag_engine.py or call ipc_clearance(voltage, layer, coated)
